subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention, and next steps (Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James O'Neill <j.oneill@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention, and next steps (Acme)

Thanks again for taking the time today, James — really appreciate the clarity on Acme's audit timeline and evidence needs. Below is my read of the discussion and proposed next steps. If I missed or mis-prioritized anything, please flag.

Quick recap of pain points / goals you shared:
- Compliance: Acme needs SOC 2 Type II evidence for vendor review (audit window: rolling).
- Audit logs: desire to access detailed event logs (user activity, API access, config changes) and retention of 24 months for key events.
- Data residency & DPA: DPA redlines from legal (standard SAML/KMS concerns + breach notification SLA).
- Pen test evidence: summary of last pentest scope and remediation timeline; call out whether infra-provider vs application layer.

What Redwood committed to on the call:
- Share latest SOC 2 report and pen-test summary (redacted where necessary).
- Provide a DPA draft for Acme legal to review and mark up.
- Provide an example export of audit/event logs and options for longer retention (up to 24 months on Dedicated).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra/security engineer to walk the logs, retention config, and OTP/KMS integration.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) I will send the SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, and DPA draft (attached) by EOD tomorrow.
2) James / Legal to confirm any additional evidence or redlines to the DPA within 5 business days.
3) Schedule a 60-min tech deep-dive next week to validate log exports and retention approach — suggest Tue 4/21 or Wed 4/22.
4) Rishi and I will produce a mutual action plan once we have DPA feedback.

Attachments will include the SOC2 report (PDF), pen-test summary, and a DPA draft. We can share the SOC2 via secure link if you prefer not to receive a PDF over email.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum here.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: (to follow) SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf, pen-test-summary-2025.pdf, DPA-draft-Acme-20260416.pdf]

From: James O'Neill <j.oneill@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention, and next steps (Acme)

Thanks Marissa — that matches our view. A few clarifications from my side:
- Priority: SOC 2 Type II and the ability to export / retain audit logs for 24 months are blockers for procurement.
- Pen test: Acme needs scope and evidence that the latest pen test covered the public-facing inference endpoints and our threat model (we'll share our standard checklist).
- DPA: I'll loop our legal team; they'll likely push on breach notification timelines and subprocessors. Please send a redline-friendly PDF/Word.

I've attached our standard security questionnaire to the thread (Acme-security-questionnaire.xlsx). If you can populate the controls sheet or provide a concise mapping, that will speed legal review.

We prefer secure link delivery for the SOC2 and pen test docs; please use the Drive secure share you mentioned.

Regards,
James O'Neill
Security Operations, Acme Corp
[Attachment: Acme-security-questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James O'Neill <j.oneill@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention, and next steps (Acme)

Hi James — appreciate the quick response and for attaching the questionnaire. Per the call, attached are the artifacts and a short mapping to your questionnaire. If Legal wants the DPA in Word for redlines, we can provide that as well.

High-level answers (mapping to the questionnaire / controls):
- SOC 2: We are attaching the SOC 2 Type II report for the 2025 audit period. The report includes coverage of the security and availability Trust Service Criteria relevant to inference operations. [Attachment: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf]
- Pen test: We performed an external pen test (Q4 2025). Attached is a redacted executive summary and remediation status. Scope included inference API, auth, and orchestration layer; provider-managed infra tests were coordinated with the cloud vendor. [Attachment: pen-test-summary-2025.pdf]
- Audit logs & retention: For Hosted customers default retention is 90 days. For Dedicated (or via our Private deployment) we can configure retention up to 24 months and provide exportable event streams (JSON/CSV). We are including a short sample export and a note on how to request a longer retention policy. [Attachment: audit-logs-export-sample.json]
- DPA: Draft attached (PDF); please confirm whether Legal would like a Word doc for markups. [Attachment: DPA-draft-Acme-20260416.pdf]

Next steps (updated):
- I uploaded the artifacts to a secure share: https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure-share/ACME-SECURITY-2026
- Can Legal confirm preferred DPA format and any must-have clauses by 2026-04-23?
- Tech deep-dive: Rishi will coordinate times — proposed windows Tue 4/21 10:00-12:00 PT or Wed 4/22 13:00-15:00 PT.

If it helps, Rishi and I can do the tech deep-dive first and invite Stephanie from our security/ops team to walk the logs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachments: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf, pen-test-summary-2025.pdf, DPA-draft-Acme-20260416.pdf, audit-logs-export-sample.json]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: James O'Neill <j.oneill@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, retention, and next steps (Acme)

Hi James / Marissa — looping in a few operational details to make the tech deep-dive more productive.

1) Audit logs and exports
- What we can provide: requestable event exports that include API request/response metadata, auth events, user/admin actions, and deployment/configuration changes. Exports are available as NDJSON/CSV and can be scoped by time, user, or resource.
- Retention: Hosted default = 90 days. Dedicated or Private deployments can extend retention to 24 months. We can also configure an export pipeline to ship logs to your S3 for long-term retention.

2) Pen test evidence
- The attached pen-test summary is an executive-level artifact; we can provide additional suppression/redaction as required. For detailed findings we usually set an NDA addendum if more granular evidence is required.

3) DPA and subprocessors
- We will accept redlines and have a standard process for expedited review for strategic customers. We can also provide KMS/HSM integration details and our subprocessors list in the tech deep-dive.

Prep for the deep-dive
- Please share a short list of three technical questions/requirements from your security team so we can prepare evidence (examples: sample log export for a specific date, auth header traces for a given request id, retention SLA language).
- Rishi will send a calendar invite once we confirm a time.

Look forward to the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Security & Reliability, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (redacted executive summary)]
